options.description: Draw with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says of `env` and `platform`, since block elements and braille are not safe where box drawing is not.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The width of a vertical bar, and so of its column. Defaults to the widest label or value, so that neither is cut.
options.name: barWidth

options.description: `horizontal` bars grow rightwards, `vertical` upwards. Defaults to `horizontal`.
options.name: direction

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: How a number is written. Defaults to at most two decimals.
options.name: format

options.description: The columns between one vertical bar and the next. Defaults to 1.
options.name: gap

options.description: How tall a vertical chart is, in rows. Defaults to 8.
options.name: height

options.description: The widest a label may be before it is cut. Defaults to its own width.
options.name: labelWidth

options.description: The value drawn as the top. Defaults to the largest value.
options.name: max

options.description: The value drawn as the bottom. Defaults to the smallest value.
options.name: min

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: Which role colours the data. Defaults to `accent`.
options.name: role

options.description: Whether to write each value. Defaults to true.
options.name: showValues

options.description: The widest a horizontal chart may be. Defaults to `terminalWidth()`.
options.name: width
